title: The Curse of King Tut's Tomb
description: After Tutankhamun's tomb was opened in 1922, several people connected to the discovery died in later years. The famous curse story grew, although evidence for a supernatural cause is lacking.

scenes.narration: In 1922, archaeologists uncovered the sealed tomb of an Egyptian pharaoh forgotten for centuries.

scenes.narration: Inside lay golden treasures and the remarkably preserved burial chamber of Tutankhamun.
